name: Dilemma thriller (game theory)
description: A game theory thriller for The Dilemma Table, mixed in with its usual videos: a few of the fixed cast trapped in a high-stakes game in one place, told from inside the danger by the Trainer's voice, with a twist that is a real result of game theory. Pick it only for game theory thriller scripts (prompts/dilemma-thriller.md).

structure.purpose: One question to the viewer in big words over the dangerous place, already tense, then one short line promising an answer.
Where we are, who is here, what each wants, the one rule nobody can break; the clock starts.
Each choice makes it worse: an offer, a lie, a threat, a betrayal, with thoughts at the decisions and a cliffhanger.
The viewer is asked what happens next, a silence, then the surprising result shown happening and why it had to happen.
In the Trainer's dark room: it is a real puzzle or study, who found it and the year, and where the viewer meets the same thing.
The outside voice gives one thing a person can do, and the Trainer answers the opening question in one line.

hookRules: The first 3 seconds ask one question of at most 12 words about "you", spoken and shown as big words over a scene that is already tense. No greeting, no logo, no game theory words.
It is a real question that the ending answers, and it does not start with "In this video", "Did you know", "Have you ever wondered" or "Imagine".
Between 3 and 10 seconds one line promises the answer will surprise.

rules: The twist is the real result of the puzzle, game or study named at the end, worked out step by step and checked against a saved source.
Every number is the source's own. A rounded figure is spoken as about, nearly or more than, never as exact.
The story is invented to show the idea and is never passed off as a real event.
